Translation of the description:

A mother and son from the Midoriya family end up engaging in procreative sex after falling victim to a villain's vile hypnotic attack.
Left with no means to resist or use contraception, the mother and son are forced into unprotected, creampie-filled incestuous intercourse by the villain's cunning and despicable hypnosis... 🏡💕

Even after the hypnosis wears off, they find themselves unable to stop the nightly cycle of unprotected incestuous mating; they have become a pair of perverted, lust-driven individuals who simply can't get enough of each other... 🍌✨️

Man... hypnosis is truly terrifying, isn't it? (Yeah, right.)

...What would *you* do? What if you were put under a spell that turned you and your mother into a couple—forcing you to engage in unprotected sex until a baby was conceived, with absolutely no way to stop?

Of course, contraception is strictly forbidden... and you're ordered to take the day off work on her ovulation day to spend the entire time mating with each other... 💕

...But the truth is, there is no hypnosis at all. The villain simply threatened you with these words:

"You two—mother and son—are to have unprotected sex every night until a brat is made. Absolutely no contraception allowed. On ovulation days, the mother must be the one to seduce the son. If you disobey, both of you will suffer a terrible fate."

...That’s all he said...

Perhaps... with just a little push like that—with just the slightest excuse—the mother, despite her initial hesitation, would find herself unable to resist having raw, unprotected sex with her son... 💓
